resolvedFindings.title: Zentrale Begriffe sind bei erster Verwendung nicht erklärt / Key terms lack first-use explanations
resolvedFindings.evidence: intakes/LH-00.md:13-30 promises no Spec Kit experience; :45-46 uses integrations/presets, :127 and :140 collection roles/series manifest, :151 and :159 ASVS/SBOM/VEX/AI-SBOM without definitions. FR-00-005 (:121/:134) and AC-00-004 (:255/:265) require explained terms. The linked authoring profile repeats collection terminology without explaining it.
resolvedFindings.impact: New authors cannot reliably distinguish a preset, project profile, collection or series manifest; readers cannot interpret the security N/A statements. This does not meet the declared beginner-facing language contract.
resolvedFindings.remediation: Add equivalent DE/EN first-use explanations of the relevant workflow terms and security abbreviations. Preserve scope and requirement IDs; repeat a semantic language review.
resolvedFindings.reevaluationTrigger: Any change to target, bound sources, profile, policy, audience, normative language or reviewer independence.
resolvedFindings.resolutionEvidence: intakes/LH-00.md: Audience and terms, Further terms, Quality and governance, Autonomous; .specify/memory/intake-authoring-profile.md: Terms and Collection and evidence. Equivalent DE/EN explanations introduce presets, integrations, profile, collection, portable roles, manifest, ASVS, SBOM, VEX and AI-SBOM before substantive use.

resolvedFindings.title: Normative DE/EN-Fassungen sind nicht vollständig gleichwertig / Normative DE/EN text differs
resolvedFindings.evidence: FR-00-004 at intakes/LH-00.md:120 requires linking issue IDs; its EN counterpart :133 additionally requires linking intakes. AC-00-007 at :258 says unabhängiges Review, while :268 only says separate review. AC-00-004 at :255/:265 requires matching meaning. Both differences also occur in the approved issue-01 source.
resolvedFindings.impact: Required links and reviewer independence can be accepted differently depending on the selected language. Matching IDs alone do not prove equivalent requirements.
resolvedFindings.remediation: Confirm and express the same linking obligation and review-independence requirement in both languages. Align any affected source/issue through explicitly authorized repair/update, preserving receipt lineage; do not silently rehash.
resolvedFindings.reevaluationTrigger: Any change to target, bound sources, profile, policy, audience, normative language or reviewer independence.
resolvedFindings.resolutionEvidence: intakes/LH-00.md and docs/issue-updates/issue-01-repair.md: FR-00-004 requires links to both issues and intakes after creation; AC-00-007 requires a reviewer other than the author in both languages. Confirmed IAD008/IAD009 are in docs/planning/lh00-repair-decisions.md; this re-review is performed by a separate automated agent.

resolvedFindings.title: Aktuelle und historische Statusangaben getrennt / Current and historical status separated
resolvedFindings.evidence: The initial candidate labeled the corrected Issue 1 input published before publication; bound governance, environment, profile and guidance still described original local-only/unpublished authoring as current. IAD001-IAD007 reused predecessor source ID SRC007 without explicit historical qualification.
resolvedFindings.impact: Readers could confuse historical authoring, actual publication, current repair/review authority and future process acceptance.
resolvedFindings.remediation: Author corrected factual status and reader paths, preserved predecessor snapshots and rebound successor receipt sources/context; reviewer changed no target/source.
resolvedFindings.resolutionEvidence: Issue input now requires separate publication evidence. Current source documents distinguish historical authoring from authorized repair/review/delivery. Historical IAD source IDs are explicitly scoped to the archived predecessor. Target points to current review for the next action and marks original validation as historical. DE/EN wording, all source/context hashes and final target hash were rechecked.
resolvedFindings.reevaluationTrigger: Publication, authority, target or source-context changes; stale status wording or changed source hashes.
